name: Praweena NS
tagline: Poetry in Thread, Modern in Silhouette.
bio: I am a fashion designer, costume design researcher, and founder of the luxury atelier KHAIRA, as well as co-founder of Floral Fusion. Currently pursuing my B.Sc. in Costume Design and Fashion at KPR College of Arts Science and Research (2024–2027), my work harmonizes age-old artisanal craft with rigorous modern tailoring, sculpting garments that feel weightless yet emotionally resonant. With a deep commitment to sustainable provenance, botanical sensibilities, and tactile luxury, I treat every collection and design endeavor as a living narrative of fabric, movement, and form.
location: Tiruppur & Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu • Private Atelier & Virtual Consultations Worldwide

shortBio: Praweena NS is a contemporary fashion designer and costume design researcher pursuing her B.Sc. at KPR College. As founder of KHAIRA Atelier, she harmonizes age-old Indian craftsmanship with modern silhouettes. She also co-founded Floral Fusion, an artisanal gifting venture.

philosophy.heading: Design Philosophy & Artistic Manifesto
philosophy.pullQuote: A garment is not merely tailored cloth; it is poetry suspended in thread, animated only by the living body that inhabits it.
manifesto: At KHAIRA, I reject the ephemeral churn of fast fashion. Instead, I anchor each silhouette in sculptural permanence, artisanal memory, and the honest physics of tactile fiber.
My work explores the tension between structural discipline and sensual release. I marry the architectural precision of bespoke tailoring with the fluid, unstitched grace of historical Indian drapery.

Every fabric that enters my atelier has a pedigree of dignity: woven on wooden pit looms, dyed with earth minerals, and handcrafted by generational artisans whose knowledge breathes life into every yard.

pillars.title: Traditional & Contemporary Influences
pillars.subtitle: Poetry in Thread
pillars.description: Harmonizing centuries-old Indian royal court draperies and Banarasi brocades with modernist structural precision, clean lines, and kinetic geometry.

pillars.title: Textile & Material Exploration
pillars.subtitle: Craft & Surface
pillars.description: Pioneering variable-tension Ahimsa silks, botanical dye extractions (indigofera, madder, marigold), and intricate Zardozi wirework engineered to reflect natural light.

pillars.title: Sustainable Craftsmanship
pillars.subtitle: Modern Silhouette
pillars.description: Committed to cruelty-free sericulture, zero-waste circular cutting patterns, and equitable patron agreements that sustain indigenous weaver guilds across India.

brandStory.headline: The Genesis of KHAIRA: Preserving the Loom, Reimagining the Silhouette
narrative: I founded KHAIRA out of a profound reverence for India's textile legacy and a sharp desire to emancipate it from traditional confines. For centuries, our country's finest weaves were relegated to heavy, ceremonial occasions—stiff, unyielding, and bound to history.

I envisioned a different destiny: handloom Ahimsa silks transformed into razor-sharp tailored lapels; Banarasi kadhwa brocades engineered into fluid evening capes; and artisanal pleats that move with the velocity of modern life.

Today, alongside my costume design studies at KPR College and co-founding the artisanal venture Floral Fusion, I shape KHAIRA as a dedicated atelier for the discerning patron who values understated luxury, ethical provenance, and silhouettes that command presence without raising their voice.
